title: Altera Volcanic Asset Library v0.1
world_rules: Continuously active volcanoes, shield volcanoes and explosive stratovolcanoes
Lava rivers, geothermal vents and fumaroles
Dense dusty smoky twilight atmosphere with volcanic gases
Creatures with heat-resistant integument, filtered respiration, lava locomotion and chemosynthetic adaptations
